title: feat: price analytics sprint 2 — import sessions REST API
body:
## Summary
- Added 11 REST endpoints under `/api/import-sessions` for the price import feature
- Full CRUD + upload/map/match/apply/export/bulk-action flow
- 19 new integration tests covering all endpoints
- All 256 tests pass (192 API + 31 bot + 33 shared)

## Review Findings Fixed
- **IMPORTANT**: Batch hasActiveBookings query (single findMany instead of N+1 per REMOVED_ITEM)
- **IMPORTANT**: Cap pagination limit at 200
- **CONCERN**: Map endpoint now returns `{session, stats}` per spec with action breakdown

## Test plan
- [x] All 256 tests pass (baseline 173 + 83 new)
- [x] POST /upload — valid xlsx, rejected non-xlsx
- [x] POST /:id/map — mapping + stats response
- [x] GET /:id/rows — pagination, filters, hasActiveBookings
- [x] POST /:id/apply — full cycle, 409 concurrent lock
- [x] GET /:id/export — XLSX download
- [x] DELETE /:id — cleanup
